item.name: ambient-hero
item.summary: Hero composition: ambient canvas (mesh/noise/particles) + TextReveal + MagneticButton (DOM+WebGL, ~8 KB, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> T2)

useWhen: Primary landing page hero section requiring an ambient signature moment with high contrast
Marketing page header with animated headline text reveal and magnetic action buttons
Showcasing a flagship product release with accessible ambient background motion
avoidWhen: Secondary pages or documentation headers where ambient motion distracts from content
Dense data dashboards or form-heavy internal tools
Pages already containing another full-viewport WebGL context above the fold

alternatives.name: noise-field
alternatives.when: When you only need a standalone background canvas without integrated typography or CTAs

alternatives.name: text-reveal
alternatives.when: When you only need headline text reveal animation without ambient background or CTAs

tiers.0: Static gradient poster background, plain un-split headline, static buttons
tiers.1: Static gradient poster background, plain un-split headline, touch-safe static buttons
tiers.2: WebGL ambient background at DPR <= 1.5, word-level text reveal, touch-safe static buttons
tiers.3: Full WebGL ambient background at DPR <= 2, word-level text reveal, fine pointer magnetic pull

reducedMotion.description: Renders static CSS gradient poster background with 0 WebGL canvases and 0 animation frames; headline renders immediately without splitting or keyframes; buttons remain static

input.pointer: Fine pointer activates magnetic CTA attraction and interactive pause control
input.touch: Touch devices disable magnetic spring pull; CTA buttons and pause control respond to direct tap
input.keyboard: Fully keyboard navigable: Tab lands on pause control and CTAs with prominent focus rings; Enter/Space activates

a11y.notes: Single semantic h1 heading for the document. Text overlay preserves >= 4.5:1 contrast against ambient canvas via multi-stop scrim. WCAG 2.2.2 pause button controls ambient motion. All text stays in the accessibility tree.

props.name: variant
props.effect: Selects which ambient background generator to mount (at most 1 WebGL context).

props.name: eyebrow
props.effect: Small pill tag displayed above the headline.

props.name: title
props.effect: Primary document h1 heading revealed word by word.

props.name: description
props.default: Near-field studio monitors engineered for uncoloured listening environments.
props.effect: Supporting description copy below the headline.

props.name: primaryCta
props.effect: Primary action button with magnetic pull.

props.name: secondaryCta
props.effect: Secondary action button with magnetic pull.

props.name: showPauseButton
props.effect: Renders an accessible pause/resume button for ambient background motion.

props.name: className
props.effect: Additional CSS class names on root header.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles applied to root header.

agent.usage:
import { AmbientHero } from '@/components/ui/ambient-hero';

<AmbientHero variant="mesh" title="Acoustic precision, sculpted in aluminum." />
mistakes: Do not place a second WebGL item above the fold alongside AmbientHero (violates single signature moment rule).
Do not remove the scrim layer; it guarantees >= 4.5:1 text contrast across light and dark modes.
verify: Verify that exactly one <h1> element exists in the rendered DOM.
Verify that the pause button toggles motion and has valid aria-label.
Verify that reduced-motion preferences render a static poster with 0 canvases.
